conditionally_prohibited_field_names.sequence_hash: PUBLIC intake records: an unsalted hash derived directly from raw_sequence is prohibited — it functions as a sequence proxy and enables de-anonymization. INTERNAL/private artifacts (e.g., design_package.json internal fields): a salted HMAC fingerprint is allowed when NOT co-transmitted with raw_sequence. Use design_package_id as the public linkage key in all intake records.
